summary: Describes how to register character sets with IANA. Many protocols, including MIME, can use many charsets, so a name for each charset is needed and an indication of whether it can be used in MIME text. It was replaced by RFC 2978.

eli5.summary: It is the process for giving a standard name to each way of encoding text, so programs agree on what they are reading.

questions: how to register a charset with iana
what is the iana charset registry
